purpose: Research fixtures for Community AI Navigator. Suggested relevance expectations, not legal, clinical or eligibility decisions.
constraintsMostlyFreeText: Age limits and eligibility in who
Self-contact versus professional referral in access
Fees and booking requirements in check/access
Geographic coverage of many wider-support records
recommendations: AI may extract intent and suggest record IDs. Validate IDs, scope, user filters and special access caveats using canonical records before displaying cards.

Do not rely on national:true alone: only 35/786 have this metadata. Other legitimate national wider records include AA, NA, SMART, ADHD UK and Stonewall Housing; some wider records are London/regional only. Use verified explicit record-level scope or cautious wider-support presentation.
Use audience constraints only where the query or filter explicitly supplies them. Do not infer gender, faith, ethnicity, sexuality or disability.
Make exact activity/organisation terms meaningful. A general meet-people intent should not swallow board games, gentle walking, faith or AA/NA specificity.
For multi-need queries show clear groups or one best route per need; avoid a single legal or housing category crowding out all other practical needs.
A peer can explain contact routes and help prepare questions. Preserve professional-referral requirements as asking the care team, without implying the peer can authorise referrals or placements.
If the query is unclear ask a single useful area/need question. Always allow ordinary directory browsing and reset.
Do not generate contacts, vacancies, eligibility decisions, deadlines, opening-now status or guaranteed outcomes. Use source text and check dates.

cases.query: I am in Brent, staying on a friend’s sofa and have nowhere to sleep tonight. I also need help with money.
requiredCaveats: Contact routes, not live beds or guaranteed accommodation.
Retain other money options but put housing first.
Do not assume the caller can make a professional referral.

cases.query: Someone needs somewhere safe to stay tonight.
cases.optionalClarifyingQuestion: Which area do they need help in?
requiredCaveats: Allow a national council finder without forcing a location answer.
Do not infer location from the browser or a protected characteristic.

cases.query: I am in Harrow and have received a notice to leave my rented flat. Where can I get legal help?
requiredCaveats: Use recorded service descriptions; do not determine the validity of a notice or invent legal deadlines.

cases.query: I live in Camden and need housing with some support after leaving hospital.
requiredCaveats: Ask the care team or adult social care about assessment; no guaranteed placement and no implication peers can allocate housing.

cases.query: I’m 22, LGBTQ+ and sofa surfing. Is there somewhere I can ask about housing online?
requiredCaveats: Age and identity were explicitly volunteered.
akt regional availability varies; do not promise housing.
Show the recorded live chat or self-contact route.

cases.query: I am a veteran and worried I will lose my home.
requiredCaveats: Op FORTITUDE assesses individual needs; do not guarantee accommodation or automatic acceptance.

cases.query: I am disabled and need advice about discrimination and reasonable adjustments.
requiredCaveats: EASS is information and informal support, not legal representation.
Each Disability Law Service advice area has its own scope and coverage.

cases.query: I have a civil court hearing and no lawyer. I need help with the paperwork.
requiredCaveats: Support Through Court does not provide legal advice or representation.
Advocate has eligibility and lead-time requirements; no promise of a barrister.

cases.query: I live in Harrow and have no income. I do not know which benefits to apply for.
requiredCaveats: Do not determine benefit entitlement.
Help to Claim is for Universal Credit, not every benefit.

cases.query: My PIP was refused and I need to challenge the decision.
requiredCaveats: Advicenow requires a free account for its tool.
Do not imply the tool submits an appeal or decide a deadline without the actual decision letter.

cases.query: I have debts and bills I cannot pay. Phone calls are difficult; is there an online option?
requiredCaveats: Use the recorded online advice or webchat route.
Do not choose a debt solution or claim that all contact is available immediately.

cases.query: I live in Brent and have no food. I do not have a foodbank voucher or anyone who can refer me.
requiredCaveats: Sufra kitchen offers recorded no-booking meals; still check the current timetable.
Food parcels may need a voucher: display the recorded route for asking, not an instruction to the peer to issue one.
Do not say every foodbank accepts walk-ins.

cases.query: I am in Milton Keynes and need food. Can I ask by text rather than phone?
requiredCaveats: The record explicitly has a text HELP route.
Copy current recorded contact details; do not generate a different SMS number.

cases.query: I would like to meet people in Camden, maybe a board game group that is easy to join.
requiredCaveats: The club uses a free ticket booking; Rogues Quarter may have charges.
Do not label every result free or drop-in.

cases.query: I am lonely in Brent and would like a gentle group walk. I am not fit enough for competitive sport.
requiredCaveats: Volleyball in the record is intermediate/advanced and not for beginners.
Do not infer a medical exercise recommendation or promise a physically accessible route.

cases.query: I am Muslim and would like to visit a mosque and meet people in Harrow.
requiredCaveats: The person explicitly requested a Muslim community.
Do not recommend a different faith because it happens to have a matching social tag.
Contact the office or recorded visit form for suitable activities.

cases.query: Could I find a church community in Ealing and ask about a first visit?
requiredCaveats: Do not assume every event is open without booking; show current calendar/contact route.

cases.query: I am autistic and would like an adult social group in Milton Keynes where I could email before going.
requiredCaveats: Email routes exist in these records; show them without promising a quiet venue or immediate place.

cases.query: I have ADHD and would like an online peer support group rather than an assessment.
requiredCaveats: ADHD Aware requires mailing-list then session booking.
Do not turn a peer-support query into clinical diagnosis or treatment advice.

cases.query: I am looking for a women’s outdoor exercise group in Westminster.
requiredCaveats: Confirm the current session with the instructor; do not promise today’s timetable or infer eligibility beyond the record.

cases.query: I would like an LGBTQ+ Muslim community to meet people with similar experiences.
requiredCaveats: Both characteristics are explicitly requested; use the intersection rather than returning unrelated faith or LGBTQ+ groups as exact matches.

cases.query: I am Deaf in Camden and need practical advice with a way to contact someone without a phone call.
requiredCaveats: Camden Disability Action explicitly offers text and a BSL video-interpreter link.
Do not claim every disabled service has BSL or that the user can use a voice phone.

cases.query: Could I find AA meetings, including online ones?
requiredCaveats: AA is an exact meeting query; do not match the CAAS substring.
No professional referral is needed according to the record; check the individual meeting.
Avoid presenting abstinence as the only recovery goal.

cases.query: I’m in Hillingdon and want NA meetings where I can go myself without a referral.
requiredCaveats: Include national NA meeting finder alongside local results even though the old wider record has no national:true flag.
Do not silently replace a specific NA query with general clinical drug services.
